mostWorthwhile.text: Building the living bone was most worthwhile: the planned cutaways connect collagen and mineral with embedded cells and their blood supply, rather than treating bone as inert material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the capsule to the bones was clear but predictable, particularly as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The lineage illustration clarified that some matrix-producing osteoblasts become embedded osteocytes with processes in tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the compatible-options menu made several later choices straightforward rather than discoveries.

continue.text: I would continue: assembling the bone and joint connected structures to their functions, although the final sequence was quite guided.
